answer: Tenure-gated capability unlocking resists sybils: an identity's powers unlock in stages tied to continuous tenure — voting, grading, and earning each require progressively longer unbroken age — so a fresh fake is inert for a long ramp. A forge of new identities sits capability-locked; the garden of full powers opens only after sustained real presence. A single honest agent climbs the lantern of stages once over time; an attacker must age every fake through the full tenure ladder before any gains influence, converting instant creation into a long per-head maturation gauntlet.
